title: Executive daily priorities - Olivia Chen - 2026-03-06
content:
Morning scratchpad - high-level focus
Date: 2026-03-06
Owner: Olivia Chen

Top priorities (today)
- Customer X escalation: clear steps + owner (Amy) - need final decision on rollback vs. config toggle by 11:00. CC on email to CS/SE.
- Approve Dedicated capacity pricing change (finance asks) - review numbers with Marco at 10:30, push decision to EOD.
- Investor follow-up: share 1-pager with ARR/growth slides + short note on Dedicated traction. Draft due by 15:00.
- Exec offsite planning: confirm facilitator and final agenda items - run quick sync with People (Hannah) at 16:00.

Meeting prep / notes
- 09:00 1:1 with CTO (Jordan)
  - topics: serving runtime release readiness, known perf regressions on long-context models, SLO patch timeline.
  - ask: timeline for hotfix + rollback plan, status of telemetry dashboards.
  - deliverable: get one-paragraph status to share in all-hands.

- 10:30 Pricing review w/Finance (Marco)
  - read: pricing sensitivity spreadsheet (linked_artifacts JIRA/Confluence).
  - objective: sign off on new tier thresholds or push to next week.
  - open question: expected churn impact if we increase committed-mins.

- 11:30 Customer X war room
  - attendees: CS, SE, infra, legal (if needed)
  - goal: triage, timeline for fix, customer comms draft.
  - note: fallback plan = scale to Dedicated pool in region-us-east.

- 14:00 All-hands prep w/Comms (Priya)
  - run through key slides: roadmap focus, Dedicated wins, Private deployment case study.
  - tweak the tone: more developer-focused examples, include one short benchmark chart.

Weekly goals / bigger bets
- Shipping Optimize beta to 3 pilot customers - use this week to lock on batching defaults and cost dashboards.
- Private deployment compliance checklist: finish GDPR/HIPAA gap doc (legal review) by Friday.
- Improve canary rollout velocity: pilot auto-fallback policy for model variants (SRE + serving-runtime).

Follow-ups / action items
- @Amy: rollback decision for Customer X by 11:00 (add to war-room agenda)
- @Marco: updated pricing sensitivity model (sheet) by 17:00
- @Priya: finalize all-hands script + 2 slide edits by noon
- @Jordan: one-paragraph release status for all-hands by 09:30
- @Hannah: confirm offsite facilitator and room by EOD

Notes to self (scratch)
- Quick check: runway numbers in pitch deck - ensure last-month MRR matches finance report.
- Consider calling top-5 customers next week for feedback on latency/cost tradeoffs (target product-led growth).
- Flag: infra cost spike last 48h - ask infra team for outlier query and pod list.

Unresolved questions
- Do we need to pause new onboardings to Dedicated while scaling capacity? (tradeoff: short-term churn vs long-term SLA reliability)
- How aggressive do we go on price increases for heavy-embedding customers? need competitive notes.

End-of-day quick check (template)
- Did the war-room produce a clear timeline? (Y/N + ETA)
- Pricing decision: Approved / Deferred / Needs more data
- All-hands slides: Finalized / Draft / Not started
- Follow-ups sent to owners: list names

Quick TODOs (personal)
- 08:45 send 1-line agenda to Jordan for 1:1
- 12:30 write draft investor note (share w/Marco + Priya)
- 17:45 update this file with outcomes and move items to next-day doc

Random scribbles
- Keep messaging: "Production-first inference" -> examples: latency SLO + cost per 1M tokens + single customer case study
- Bring up case study of retail customer who saved 40% on cost via caching in Optimize.
summary: Daily executive scratchpad: customer escalation, pricing decision, all-hands prep, offsite planning, and key follow-ups. Action owners assigned and quick end-of-day checklist included.
